agreement_diagnostics: intent support-count distribution (5/5, 4/5, 3/5, 2/5, bare plurality) and the delivered intent accuracy within each stratum
entities kept and dropped by the support filter, by slot type, with the resulting false positive and false negative movement against the base
malformed sample count, and the rows where fewer than five samples parsed
rows whose delivered answer differs from sample 0

arm.role: cell B2, five sampled Solver answers at temperature 0.7, commit s = 3 of 5

base_cell_b0.role: primary comparator, sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

secondary_anchor.role: secondary comparator, sealed bytes, never re-flown or re-scored

twin.role: cell B2's greedy-repeat twin, five samples at temperature 0, same commit

claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows. No superiority, generalization, component-causal or confirmatory claim; nothing about Fold B, DEV-1000 or the test split.

contrasts.role: diagnostic: what the aggregation alone buys
secondary, reported beside the base contrast

decision_rule.ADMITTED: CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta > 0 against BOTH the base and the twin, intent non-inferior within 0.92 pp, normalised scorer same sign, no scenario intent loss beyond the null band
decision_rule.HARMFUL: an interval excludes non-inferiority on SLU or intent
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: non-inferior but not admitted; enters the plan only if it lowers cost

delta_convention: delta = arm minus comparator, in percentage points; negative is worse

estimators.commit_replay: analysis.native_commit_replay.replay_row over each sealed outputs row's solver_group, for the reported-only s in {2,3,4} sensitivity table
estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler
roster_metadata.speaker_key: spk:<usrid> from the governed SLURP release metadata, the 2026-09-09 own-null convention

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer

tables_required: headline: base (cell B0), arm, twin, both deltas, speaker CI95, speaker CI90, scenario-stratified CI90, equal-scenario delta, and the anchor column
saves / harms / ties with the exact two-sided McNemar p for every per-row metric, against base and against twin
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting
the REPORT-ONLY offline sensitivity table for s in {2, 3, 4} at char-F1 0.8
cost table: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, duty cycle, prompt-cache behaviour
